design_philosophy: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level. Premium SaaS meets Gaming Platform. Strictly monochrome (black, dark-gray, white), generous negative space, deliberate typography, and high-end motion design.

rules: CRITICAL: No colored accents whatsoever. No blue, no red, no green, no purple.
Glow effects must use white/grey transparent gradients.
Always use optical clarity for glassmorphism: heavy blur with extremely low opacity white borders.

hierarchy.h1: text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] tracking-tighter leading-[0.9] font-light

rules: Use extremely tight tracking (-0.04em) on massive text.
Avoid bold weights for giant text; rely on font-light or font-normal.

layouts_and_spacing.grid: Mobile-first, 12-column bento-inspired grids on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) with gap-6 or gap-8.
layouts_and_spacing.section_padding: py-24 md:py-32 or py-40 for major sections to ensure premium breathing room.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Strictly optical. Left-align body copy and features. Center alignment reserved strictly for specific editorial moments.

motion_and_interaction.smooth_scrolling: Lenis is MANDATORY. Momentum scrolling makes the site feel heavy and premium.
motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal for H1. Initial y: 100%, duration: 1.2s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], staggerChildren: 0.1s.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveal: Elements fade in and translate Y up by 40px on scroll (Framer Motion whileInView). Viewport margin: -100px.
motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Subtle 3D tilt on cards (use Framer Motion). Scale down buttons slightly on tap (scale: 0.98).
motion_and_interaction.custom_cursor: Small white dot tracking the mouse (mix-blend-mode: difference), expands when hovering interactive elements.
motion_and_interaction.page_loader: Minimalistic black screen with a single white line or percentage counter that masks out upwards on load.

3d_and_effects.hero_scene: Dark abstract geometric or organic shapes rotating very slowly in the background. Material must be very dark grey/black with slight specular white highlights.
3d_and_effects.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky nav and modal overlays: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5.
3d_and_effects.parallax: Apply subtle Y-axis translate on background imagery and 3D canvas relative to scroll position.

Home.layout: Kinetic Hero -> Editorial Marquee -> Numbered Manifesto -> Featured Products/Stats -> Footer
Home.details: Hero: 'FLUXGG REBORN\nNowa era roleplay.' Buttons: GRAJ TERAZ (Solid White), DISCORD (Outline). Marquee: Slow-moving uppercase text separated by simple dots.

Płatności (Payments).card_style: Dark panel, 1px border. On hover, 3D tilt effect with a white inner glow. 'KUP TERAZ' primary button.

Regulamin (Rules).layout: Large search input on top -> Custom Accordion lists.
Regulamin (Rules).components: Shadcn Accordion. Strip away all default Vercel-like styling. Border-bottom only, large clean typography.

Profil (Profile).layout: Dashboard-style Bento Grid. Left column: User Info. Right column: Stats & History.
Profil (Profile).badges: Verification badges MUST NOT use green. Use white outlines with a faint white text shadow for 'STEAM ZWERYFIKOWANY'.

O nas (About Us).layout: Cinematic text sections and large animated stat counters.
O nas (About Us).counters: GRACZE, AKTYWNYCH CZŁONKÓW, GODZIN ROZGRYWKI, EVENTÓW. Text size: text-[5rem] or larger, tracking-tighter.

Weryfikacja (Verification).layout: Two massive connection cards centered vertically.
Weryfikacja (Verification).states: Niepołączono (greyed out), Weryfikowanie (subtle white spinner), Zweryfikowano (white text, glow).

Podania (Applications).layout: Masonry or clean grid of Application Types (Whitelist, Administracja, Frakcja, Biznes, Ekipa).
Podania (Applications).interaction: Clicking a card opens a heavily styled Shadcn Dialog (Modal) containing the application form.

components.Button: No rounded-full unless for icons. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm. Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-[#E5E5E5]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#262626] text-white hover:border-[#737373].
components.Navbar: Sticky top. MUST have background (e.g., bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-md). Never fully transparent. Links hover effect: opacity change or underline reveal.
components.Cards: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#1A1A1A] p-8 md:p-12. Deep shadows are banned; use 1px borders and subtle inner glows for depth.

images.description: Abstract black and white 3D object with smooth curves
Curved black ribbons with soft lighting

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid="nav-login-button"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white text (#FFFFFF) is used against the pure black background (#050505) for primary readability. Muted text must not fall below WCAG AA requirements.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Wrap massive animations in prefers-reduced-motion media queries.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You have .js files not .tsx file, so configure routes and components in standard JS.
No generic centered layouts. Exploit asymmetrical bento grids and hard left alignments.
The app container must NOT be center-aligned.
Do not use generic button styling. Adopt sharp, high-end monochrome buttons with micro-interactions.
Never apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions: `transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease`.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn exclusively for logic-heavy components (Accordions, Dialogs).
Integrate Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout wrapper.
Integrate Sonner for toast notifications. Customize the toast to be pure black with a white border.
NO EMOJIS in the UI. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React with extremely thin stroke weights.
